kpis.name: Schedule Performance Index (SPI)
kpis.description: Ratio of earned value to planned value, measuring schedule efficiency against baseline
kpis.formula: SPI = EV / PV

kpis.name: Cost Performance Index (CPI)
kpis.description: Ratio of earned value to actual cost, measuring cost efficiency
kpis.formula: CPI = EV / AC

kpis.name: Critical Path Float Consumption
kpis.description: Remaining float on the longest path; negative float indicates behind-schedule
kpis.formula: LF - EF on critical path tasks

kpis.name: Engineering Progress (% IFC drawings issued)
kpis.description: Percentage of IFC drawings issued vs planned for the current phase
kpis.formula: (IFC drawings issued / total planned) x 100

kpis.name: VDR Cycle Time (critical packages)
kpis.description: Average time from vendor document submission to engineering approval for critical equipment packages
kpis.formula: Average(TBE issue date - vendor submission date) for critical packages

kpis.name: Construction Progress (S-Curve compliance)
kpis.description: Actual progress vs planned S-curve, measured in installed quantities or earned hours
kpis.formula: Actual % complete - Planned % complete at reporting date
kpis.source: Construction daily reports / progress measurement system

kpis.name: Lookahead Plan Compliance (3-week)
kpis.description: Percentage of planned lookahead activities completed per schedule
kpis.formula: (Activities completed / Activities planned in 3-week lookahead) x 100

kpis.name: Milestone Achievement Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of project milestones achieved on the scheduled date or earlier
kpis.formula: (Milestones achieved on time / Total milestones due) x 100

kpis.name: Cost Commitment vs Budget
kpis.description: Total committed spend (POs placed plus incurred costs) as percentage of total budget
kpis.formula: (Actual committed + actual spend) / Total budget x 100

kpis.name: Change Order Volume (count)
kpis.description: Total number of change orders raised during the project, indicating scope stability
kpis.formula: Cumulative change orders raised

kpis.name: Change Order Value Impact
kpis.description: Net cost impact of approved and pending change orders as percentage of original budget
kpis.formula: (Sum of approved & pending change order values / Original budget) x 100

kpis.name: Contract Claim Value at Risk
kpis.description: Total value of disputed claims (owner vs contractor) that may result in settlement costs
kpis.formula: Sum of all disputed claim values

kpis.name: Engineering Cost Performance (budget vs actual hours)
kpis.description: Engineering man-hours spent vs budgeted for current phase
kpis.formula: (Actual hours / Budgeted hours - 1) x 100

kpis.name: S-Curve Variance
kpis.description: Planned vs actual cumulative progress S-curve deviation at reporting period
kpis.formula: Absolute(Actual S-curve % - Planned S-curve %)

kpis.name: Weld NDT Rejection Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of production welds failing NDT (RT/UT/PAUT) on first inspection
kpis.formula: (Failed welds / Total welds tested) x 100

kpis.name: NCR Closure Time (average)
kpis.description: Average time from NCR issue to close-out (verification completed)
kpis.formula: Average(Close-out date - Issue date) for NCRs closed this period

kpis.name: Open NCR Count
kpis.description: Total number of open NCRs, trending direction indicates quality health
kpis.formula: Total open NCRs at reporting date

kpis.name: Hydrotest Package Completion Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of piping hydrotest packages completed and certified
kpis.formula: (Packages completed / total packages) x 100
kpis.source: Hydrotest package register / piping completion system

kpis.name: Punch List Item Count (open)
kpis.description: Total open punch list items — should decrease as project approaches mechanical completion
kpis.formula: Total open punch list items at reporting date

kpis.name: ITP Compliance Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of inspection and test plan hold points witnessed/completed per schedule
kpis.formula: (ITP hold points completed / ITP hold points scheduled) x 100

kpis.name: Lost Time Incident (LTI) Rate
kpis.description: Number of lost-time injuries per 200,000 man-hours worked
kpis.formula: (Number of LTIs x 200,000) / Total man-hours worked

kpis.name: Total Recordable Incident Rate (TRIR)
kpis.description: Total recordable injuries (LTI + restricted work + medical treatment) per 200,000 man-hours
kpis.formula: (Total recordable incidents x 200,000) / Total man-hours

kpis.name: Near-Miss Reporting Rate
kpis.description: Number of near-miss reports per 200,000 man-hours (leading indicator)
kpis.formula: (Near-miss reports x 200,000) / Total man-hours

kpis.name: Safety Observation / Intervention Rate
kpis.description: Number of safety observations / interventions conducted per month
kpis.formula: Total safety observations recorded in period

kpis.name: PTW Compliance / Non-Compliance Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of permits audited that are fully compliant with PTW procedure
kpis.formula: (Compliant permits audited / Total permits audited) x 100

kpis.name: Rework Cost as % of Construction Cost
kpis.description: Cost of rework (correcting defective or incomplete work) as percentage of total construction cost
kpis.formula: (Rework cost / Total construction cost) x 100
kpis.source: Quality system / cost coding for rework

kpis.name: Mechanical Completion (MC) Certificates Issued
kpis.description: Percentage of systems for which MC certificates have been issued (system-by-system turnover)
kpis.formula: (Systems with MC issued / Total systems) x 100

kpis.name: Equipment Setting & Alignment Accuracy
kpis.description: Percentage of critical rotating equipment setting/alignment checks within OEM tolerances on first check
kpis.formula: (Items within tolerance / Total items set) x 100

kpis.name: Concrete / Foundation Quality (% defective pours)
kpis.description: Percentage of concrete pours that need remedial work (honeycombing, low strength, incorrect level)
kpis.formula: (Defective pours / Total pours) x 100

kpis.name: Performance Test Achievement (key guarantees)
kpis.description: Percentage of contractual performance guarantees met during commissioning / performance test
kpis.formula: (Guarantees met / Total guarantees in contract) x 100

kpis.name: Commissioning Schedule Variance
kpis.description: Days ahead or behind the commissioning schedule per system
kpis.formula: Actual system commission date - Planned system commission date

kpis.name: Document / Deliverable Submission Compliance
kpis.description: Percentage of contractually required deliverables submitted on time
kpis.formula: (Deliverables submitted on time / Total deliverables due) x 100

kpis.name: Construction Carbon Footprint (Scope 1 & 2)
kpis.description: Total CO2e emissions from on-site construction activities including diesel generators, construction vehicles, and grid electricity consumption during the construction phase
kpis.formula: Sum(Diesel consumed x EF_diesel + Electricity consumed x EF_grid + Gas consumed x EF_gas)
kpis.source: Site fuel/electricity consumption logs; emission factor database

kpis.name: Design Carbon Intensity (kgCO2e/kg product)
kpis.description: Process design carbon intensity — CO2e per unit of product output, tracking the impact of design decisions (material selection, energy efficiency, heat integration) on operational carbon footprint
kpis.frequency: One-time at FEED close; verified at performance test
kpis.formula: Total annual Scope 1+2 emissions / Annual production capacity (from H&MB)
kpis.source: Process simulation / H&MB; ESG consultant report

kpis.name: Waste Diversion Rate (Construction)
kpis.description: Percentage of construction and demolition waste diverted from landfill through recycling, reuse, or recovery
kpis.formula: (Waste recycled/reused / Total construction waste generated) x 100
kpis.source: Waste manifest / weighbridge tickets / contractor monthly report

kpis.name: Water Consumption During Construction
kpis.description: Total fresh water consumed for construction activities (dust suppression, concrete curing, washing, site facilities)
kpis.formula: Sum of meter readings at all construction water take-off points
kpis.source: Water meter readings / water truck logs

kpis.name: Sustainable Material Procurement (%)
kpis.description: Percentage of procured materials (by value) with third-party sustainability certification or recycled content
kpis.formula: (Value of certified/recycled-content materials / Total material procurement value) x 100

kpis.name: Flaring & Fugitive Emissions Design Target
kpis.description: Estimated annual flaring and fugitive emissions from the designed facility (flare system, valve/compressor leaks) per the FEED basis of design
kpis.target: <= regulatory limit and project charter target
kpis.formula: Flare load (H&MB) x flare efficiency x GWP + fugitive estimate per protocol (EPA/OGMP)
kpis.source: Process simulation / flare load summary; LDAR design basis

kpis.name: Noise & Dust Compliance Rate (Construction)
kpis.description: Percentage of ambient noise and particulate monitoring measurements that fall within statutory limits during construction
kpis.formula: (Compliant measurements / Total measurements) x 100
kpis.source: Environmental monitoring reports / third-party lab results

kpis.name: Biodiversity Offset / Restoration Progress
kpis.description: Progress against the biodiversity offset or restoration plan committed in the EIA approval conditions (e.g., hectares restored, trees planted)
kpis.target: 100% on schedule per biodiversity management plan
kpis.formula: (Hectares restored or offset credits purchased / Total committed) x 100
kpis.source: Biodiversity management plan / restoration contractor reports
